name: Корабль снаружи: контровой от далёкого солнца
about: Аппарат в пустоте: жёсткий контровой свет от далёкого солнца, чёрное небо без дымки, лимб планеты подсвечен по краю, панели корпуса читаются до заклёпки.
style_notes_en: painterly digital concept art with photographic weight, rendered as a film keyframe rather than a photograph or a classical painting; practical light sources visible or implied inside the frame; full value range down to true black; visible brush economy on metal and fabric while the focal object holds crisp detail; worn lived-in objects — mugs, taped paper, handwritten notes, scuffed panels — rendered with the same care as the machinery; desaturated palette split warm against cool; wide cinematic framing with foreground objects cropped by the frame edge; a spacecraft in vacuum lit by hard rim light from a distant sun, pure black sky with no atmospheric haze, a planet limb glowing along one edge, hull panelling and greebling readable down to the seam, engine glow as the only saturated colour
